new_libraries.name: pairble
new_libraries.author: Pajenicko
new_libraries.sentence: Wi-Fi setup for ESP32 over Bluetooth, nothing to install.
new_libraries.paragraph: The phone's camera opens an App Clip (iPhone) or a web page (Android, computers); the device shows the networks it can see and gets the password over an encrypted Bluetooth session. Falls back to the device's own Wi-Fi. Needs arduino-esp32 3.3 or newer.

library.name: MultiFTPServer
library.author: Renzo Mischianti <renzo.mischianti@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Multi FTP server for esp8266, esp32, STM32, Raspberry Pi Pico and Arduino
library.paragraph: Multi FTP server for Raspberry Pi Pico W (LittleFS), esp8266 (SPIFFS and LittleFS or SD, SdFat 2.x), esp32 (SPIFFS, LittleFS and FFAT or SD, SdFat 2.x) and Arduino (SdFat, SD basic lib with 8.3 file format), Wio Terminal (Seed_SD, SdFat 2.x), Arduino MKR and Nano 33 IoT (WiFiNINA, SD or SdFat 2), STM32 (Flash >64K SdFat 2.x and SPI Flash). Support w5500, w5100 and enc28j60. With internal callback to check the phase of communication.
